recipe.visualDefinition: A black-and-white photographic portrait of a musician fragmented into a loose, irregular grid of white and colored rectangular tiles, set against a deep black background with bold, condensed sans-serif typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Fragmented subject vs. solid black negative space
Monochrome photographic textures vs. flat, saturated color blocks
Irregular, hand-cut grid alignment vs. rigid typographic headers
High-contrast lighting on the subject vs. the matte finish of the tiles
coreInvariants: Irregular mosaic grid of rectangular paper scraps
Limited palette of saturated accent tiles (magenta, cyan, lime, purple)
Monochrome halftone photographic content within the tiles

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered but fragmented, with the primary focal point (the face) located in the lower-left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, laughing face in the lower-left provides the strongest emotional and visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the bold red and pink text at the top, down through the scattered colored tiles, settling on the detailed photographic fragments at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space surrounds the central mosaic, pushing the composition inward.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White (Primary tile color and photographic highlights)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Magenta, Cyan, Lime Green, and Deep Purple (Scattered tiles)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value white and high-saturation accents pop against a zero-value black field.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic font usage with color variation to distinguish between artist and title.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, mid-century display aesthetic.
Provides the necessary wood-type feel with modern precision.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a high-contrast black and white photograph of a jazz musician playing an instrument. Fragment the image into a loose, non-uniform grid of rectangular tiles. Place these tiles on a solid black background. Randomly replace approximately 10% of the tiles with flat blocks of magenta, cyan, lime green, and purple. Ensure the edges of the tiles look like cut paper with slight misalignments.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two strings of text at the top corners using an extra-condensed bold sans-serif font. The left string should be magenta and the right string should be bright red. Ensure the text is large and uppercase.

verificationChecks: Are the tiles slightly misaligned to create a hand-made feel?
Are the accent colors flat and saturated?

postGenerationChecks: Check for halftone texture in photographic tiles
Ensure no text is overlapping the mosaic
Verify the 'cut paper' edge quality of the rectangles
Confirm the color palette is limited to the specified accents
recipe.reuseFormula: Fragmented [Subject] + Irregular Rectangular Grid + [Accent Colors] + Condensed Bold Sans-Serif Headers + Black Background.
